# Eventaj.si

> Eventaj.si rents photo booths (foto stojnica, fotobox, foto kotiček), 360 photo booths and event equipment across Slovenia, and sells a QR gallery that collects guests' photos, videos and voice messages. Based in Lenart v Slovenskih goricah near Maribor. Photo booth from 279 € for 2 hours, 360 photo booth from 299 € for 2 hours, QR gallery 35 € per event.

## Services

- [Photo booth najem](https://www.eventaj.si/photo-booth): photo booth with a DSLR camera and instant printing. Unlimited photos and prints during the rental, props, a print frame personalised for the event, our staff on site for the whole rental, and a digital gallery afterwards. Packages: Basic 2 h 279 €, Standard 3 h 329 €, Premium 4 h 379 € (Standard and Premium include a small keepsake album). QR gallery add-on +25 € per event.
- [360 photo booth najem](https://www.eventaj.si/360-photo-booth): slow-motion 360° videos on a 100 cm platform, personalised animations and sound, sharing by QR code or AirDrop, props and a digital frame. Packages: Mini 2 h 299 €, Osnovni 3 h 349 €, Maxi 4 h 399 €. QR gallery add-on +35 € per event.
- [QR galerija](https://www.eventaj.si/qr-galerija): one QR code on the tables; guests scan it and upload photos, short videos and voice messages from the browser, with no app or registration. 35 € per event, gallery available for 180 days after the event, up to 20 videos of up to 60 seconds in the basic package (+15 € removes the video limit). [Features](https://www.eventaj.si/qr-galerija/funkcije), [for weddings](https://www.eventaj.si/qr-galerija/poroka), [for business events](https://www.eventaj.si/qr-galerija/poslovni-dogodek).
- [Cenik](https://www.eventaj.si/cenik): all packages and add-ons in one place.

Add-ons: extra hour photo booth +50 €, extra hour 360 photo booth +80 €, personalised 360 animations +59 €, small album +20 € with 2 h (included from 3 h), large album +30 € with 2 h or +15 € from 3 h, 10 personalised wooden signs to keep +40 €.

"Photo booth", "foto stojnica", "fotobox", "foto box" and "foto kotiček" are names Slovenian customers use for the same service; Eventaj offers one photo booth service under all of these names.

## Photo booth by event

- [Foto kotiček za poroko](https://www.eventaj.si/photo-booth-za-poroko): prints personalised with the couple's names and date; every photo is printed twice, one copy goes into a guest book.
- [Photo booth za rojstni dan](https://www.eventaj.si/photo-booth-za-rojstni-dan)
- [Photo booth za obletnico](https://www.eventaj.si/photo-booth-za-obletnico): anniversaries, 50th birthdays (abraham) and golden weddings.
- [Photo booth za poslovni dogodek](https://www.eventaj.si/photo-booth-za-poslovni-dogodek): company logo on every print; Christmas parties, team buildings, conferences.
- 360 photo booth: [poroka](https://www.eventaj.si/360-booth-za-poroko), [rojstni dan](https://www.eventaj.si/360-booth-za-rojstni-dan), [poslovni dogodek](https://www.eventaj.si/360-booth-za-poslovni-dogodek), [promocija znamke](https://www.eventaj.si/360-booth-za-promocijo), [festival](https://www.eventaj.si/360-booth-za-festival).

## Service area and transport

All of Slovenia. Transport and setup are free within 20 km of Lenart v Slovenskih goricah; for other locations travel costs are quoted in advance as part of the offer.

## Event equipment and personalized products

- [Standing cocktail tables](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/najem-stojecih-miz): €10 per table per day, white or black tablecloth included, up to 15 tables.
- [Welcome sign](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/tabla-dobrodoslice): rental from €29 or personalized purchase from €59, stand included with rental.
- [Table numbers](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/stevilke-miz): acrylic numbers with stands, rental from €1.90 per table.
- [Place names](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/imena-za-na-kroznik): personalized white or natural wood names from €1.90 each, minimum 40.
- [Guest book frame](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/knjiga-gostov-v-okvirju): personalized heart or tree design, €175 with 150 wooden pieces or €200 with 200 pieces.
- [Wedding puzzle](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/porocni-puzzle): personalized wooden signing puzzle with names and date, €200 for 90 pieces or €250 for 160 pieces.
- [Event games](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/igre-za-dogodke): wooden games for weddings and company events, four-game package from €149.
- [Beer pong table](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/beer-pong-miza): wedding or LED version for €49 per day; personalization is not available and transport is charged separately.
- [Guest fans](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/pahljace-za-goste): personalized double-sided printed fans, €3 each for 50–99 pieces, €2.50 each for 100–199 pieces, and €2 each from 200 pieces; minimum 50 pieces.

The product category is available at https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke. Welcome signs, wedding puzzles, guest book frames, table numbers, place names, and guest fans can be shipped by post; postage is always charged separately. Standing tables are delivered for orders of 5 or more tables within 50 km of Maribor; fewer than 5 tables are personal pickup only. Event games and beer pong tables require transport to the venue up to 75 km. Transport is charged separately at €0.40/km. Rental stock depends on the event date. Personalized products require production time, which is stated on each product page.
